title: Relevant coordinate of a restricted function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $P$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs on $P$. A coordinate $i$ outside $P$ is relevant to the resulting restriction if there are two sign assignments on the remaining coordinates that agree at every coordinate other than $i$ but give different values of the restricted function.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
